name: Layout Builder extras - View mode selector
description: View mode selector on steriods: Allows to select which VM to be exposed + icons.
project_description:
Back to top 

 What does it do? 
 It allows you to add icons/images to your view modes so it's nicer and more user friendly to select a view mode in the front end.

It used to be a select list of all view modes and now it's a selectable "list" with icons.

 On every block content type you can select which view modes should be exposed to the frontend and which icons/images should be added.

 Back to top 

 How does it differ to the other "view mode selectors" 
 
 Well this module builds upon core 
 No need to add extra fields and other stuff. 
 Allows it to be deployable! (Path to image + exportable via config)
